uncertainties.detail: The decisive bridge is a telephone number, not a page that prints Marsala's name beside the yacht. Naughty By Nature's official charter site uses +356 7703 4283, exactly matching the number printed beside Maria Marsala in Brema Management's 2018 advertisement. The source relationship starts in the same month as the yacht's October 2021 sale, and the yacht operates under a Malta flag from Grand Harbour. Together with the exact-name Malta business record, this exceeds the identity threshold while remaining below very-high confidence.

More than forty LinkedIn profiles use the name Maria Marsala, including professionals in the United States, Canada and Europe. The New York financial-adviser coach, Nashville executive assistant, French hotel-company manager and other namesakes were rejected because none shares the Benat company, Malta location or yacht-linked telephone number.

Corporate and court records use Maria Abela Marsala, while the source record uses Maria Marsala. Abela is proposed as the missing middle-name value because it falls between the recorded first and last names and the registry explicitly links Maria Abela as the same person. The dossier does not attempt broader legal-name restructuring.

Marsala was born in Gzira, has a Maltese identity record and has long-standing Malta residence and business ties. Those facts do not independently prove current citizenship, so Maltese nationality is not proposed; birthplace, birth country and current residence are treated separately.

All four wealth fields remain Unknown independently. Public records establish trading, management, company-secretary and consultancy roles but do not establish equity ownership, company scale, transaction proceeds, a dominant current holding or how Marsala obtained the resources associated with the owner record.

A 2004 judgment identifies Olga Marsala as Maria's aunt and records that they traded together. That relationship is not treated as evidence of inheritance, a family-business transfer or advantaged starting capital; no family-succession classification or tag is assigned.

Business services is an inactive catalogue term, and the active yacht-charter concepts require a defining operating or wealth relationship not established merely by a shared contact number and the owner record. No tag is assigned and no candidate is created.

The date and place of birth come from an exact-full-name official court record independently tied through the Benat registry identity. The proposal retains only the requested biographical fields; private addresses, identity-card numbers, allegations and case outcomes are omitted.

The Malta LinkedIn profile is proposed because its exact Benat Tradings affiliation is independently corroborated by corporate-registry data. Searches of Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube, TikTok and personal websites did not produce another account with an official cross-link or two strong independent identity confirmations.

The 52-word short biography identifies Marsala through Malta, Benat and Brema. The 90-word long biography instead traces the career chronology from Noto Trading through Benat's statutory roles to Brema's service offer. Both omit the yacht, legal controversy, evidentiary caveats, wealth verdicts and unsupported current ownership claims.

Exact-ID inventory preceded the mandatory Forbes-first public-web search. The target dossier was absent immediately before drafting, so no backup was needed. Only this assigned dossier is written; no owner input, catalogue, code, progress marker or live record is changed.
